formulas.name: de Broglie Wavelength
formulas.description: Relates wavelength lambda to particle momentum p using Planck constant h.

formulas.name: Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle
formulas.description: Fundamental limit on the precision of position and momentum measurements.

flashcards.front: What is the de Broglie hypothesis?
flashcards.back: All matter exhibits wave-like behavior with a wavelength inversely proportional to its momentum: lambda = h / p.
It is impossible to simultaneously measure the exact position and momentum of a subatomic particle with arbitrary precision: Delta x * Delta p >= hbar / 2.

practice_questions.question: Calculate the de Broglie wavelength of an electron moving at 1.0 x 10^6 m/s.
